annotations.title: All observations of a fact (pro key)

description: PRO KEY ONLY. For one robot (`slug`), every accepted observation of each fact (same predicate, same conditions): all the sources that state it, replaced and outdated values included, each with its source, dates and level of evidence. `predicate` narrows to one fact (e.g. price.msrp). `locale: "fr"` for French values. Without a pro key the answer points to https://vuntum.com/en/entreprise#demande.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

slug.description: URL identifier of the robot sheet, for example "g1".
